name: Bank of America® Customized Cash Rewards Credit Card

localized_names.en: Bank of America® Customized Cash Rewards Credit Card

apr.notes: 0% intro APR for the first 15 billing cycles for purchases and balance transfers made within 60 days; then a variable APR of 16.49% to 28.49% applies. The sample agreement states APRs are based on the Prime Rate as of 03/31/2026. Actual pricing will vary from one cardholder to another. Intro APR offer preserved from previous data; not re-verified (product page was unavailable).

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee is 3% of each transaction.

base_rate.description: Unlimited 1% cash back on all other purchases

categories.label: Choice category for the first year
Choice category after the first year

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash rewards can be redeemed for statement credits, deposits to eligible Bank of America accounts, eligible Merrill accounts, qualifying 529 contributions, checks, Amazon.com, or PayPal; some redemption methods have a $25 minimum.

signup_bonus.description: $200 online cash rewards bonus after making at least $1,000 in purchases in the first 90 days of account opening. Preserved from previous data; not re-verified (product page was unavailable).

benefits.title: BofA Rewards bonus eligibility
benefits.description: Eligible Bank of America customers enrolled in BofA Rewards can earn a rewards bonus on credit card purchases. Preserved from previous data; not re-verified (product page was unavailable).

benefits.title: $0 Liability Guarantee
benefits.description: Bank of America provides a $0 Liability Guarantee for fraudulent transactions. Preserved from previous data; not re-verified (product page was unavailable).

benefits.title: Balance Connect overdraft protection
benefits.description: Optional overdraft protection service when linking an eligible Bank of America checking account to the credit card; other fees may apply. Preserved from previous data; not re-verified (product page was unavailable).

notes: The product page was temporarily unavailable during verification. APR and FX fee were verified from the official sample Credit Card Agreement PDF (Prime Rate as of 03/31/2026). The sample agreement states 'Actual pricing will vary from one cardholder to another.' Rewards structure, signup bonus, and benefits preserved from previous data and not re-verified. The previous APR range (17.49-27.49) has been updated to match the sample agreement (16.49-28.49). FX fee was previously null and is now confirmed as 3% from the sample agreement.
